name: Guardian: Shield of Denial is a physical ability and stays usable while silenced (#8255)
contract: Shield of Denial 704159 (and rank 707701) deals Physical damage and interrupts, like Heroic Throw and Shield Slam, but Spell.dbc set PreventionType 1 (SPELL_PREVENTION_TYPE_SILENCE), so a silence refused it. Physical weapon abilities use PreventionType 2 (PACIFY), which only a disarm/pacify blocks. A silenced Guardian must still throw the shield, and the same cast without the silence must behave identically.
